query:
SELECT ei.evaluatedStudentId, COUNT(*) as count
FROM evaluation_items ei
JOIN evaluations e ON e.id = ei.evaluationId
WHERE e.sessionId = 720002 AND ei.evaluatedStudentId = 300027
GROUP BY ei.evaluatedStudentId;
